At ENGIE, we accelerate the energy transition by building reliable, secure, and innovative digital infrastructure. Our Global Business Support teams power the technology that keeps energy flowing for millions of people worldwide.
We are looking for an Azure Specialist to join our Operations team. You will ensure the availability, security, and performance of our Cloud environments. Your expertise will directly support ENGIE's business units and contribute to a more sustainable future.
 What You'll Do
 Manage and operate Azure Cloud infrastructure, including IaaS, PaaS, and serverless services, ensuring high availability at all times.
 Maintain security compliance aligned with ENGIE Group policies and resolve vulnerabilities proactively.
 Deploy and administer virtual machines, containers, and platform services in collaboration with Cloud partners.
 Automate infrastructure deployment and management using Terraform, Bicep, Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines.
 Monitor and supervise existing environments, identify incidents, and perform root cause analysis from Level 1 to Level 3.
 Advise and support business units during go-to-run processes, sharing deep Cloud expertise.
 Write and maintain technical documentation, architecture files, and operational procedures.
 What You Bring
 2 to 4 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure (Containers, IaaS, PaaS, Serverless).
 Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) certification is mandatory.
 Solid knowledge of networking (DNS, security groups), Linux or Windows administration, and scripting (PowerShell, Python, Bash).
 Experience with DevOps tooling: Docker, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Terraform, and JIRA.
 Familiarity with databases such as PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB, SQL Server, or Oracle, and monitoring tools like Grafana and Azure Monitor.
 Strong understanding of ITIL processes, production traceability, and change management.
 Fluency in English (B2 minimum, spoken and written). French is a plus.
 Ability to work in a multicultural, cross-functional team with a results-oriented mindset and willingness to share knowledge.
 On-call duty and interventions during non-working hours are required.
 What We Offer
 A competitive salary package with clear career progression within a global energy leader.
 A diverse range of missions across Cloud technologies, security, automation, and architecture.
 Stimulating technical challenges in a fast-evolving digital environment that supports the energy transition.
 A friendly, collaborative team culture where knowledge sharing is valued.
 Flexibility and work-life balance through our hybrid working model.
 Access to certifications, training programs, and continuous professional development.
 Only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted. 
 If you decide to send us your personal information in order to apply for this position, please be aware of our job candidate GDPR Data Privacy Notice: https://www.engie.ro/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/ER_Nota-de-informare-Candidati.pdf .
 Our Commitment
 At ENGIE, every talent has a role to play in accelerating the energy transition. Make a difference and enjoy a fulfilling professional experience. Take on exciting challenges and build a career path that reflects who you are. Join us and be part of the adventure of the century!
ENGIE is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants based on their skills, experience, and potential. We do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, age, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or any other protected characteristic.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process. If you need any adjustments, please let us know so we can support you at every step.
